summary.text: Pat Outman is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 91 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists his House service as beginning in 2021.
A Six Lakes native with a background in construction and excavation, he chairs the House Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Outman was born in Six Lakes, Michigan, where he lives, and graduated from Lakeview High School in 2010.
He earned a bachelor's degree in business administration and legal studies from Ferris State University.

His career experience includes work in the construction and excavation industries, and he has served as chairman of the Montcalm County Republican Party and on the board of the Montcalm County Farm Bureau.
In the 2025-2026 session Outman chairs the Transportation Committee and serves on the Economic Competitiveness, Elections and Ethics, and Natural Resources and Outdoor Recreation committees.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Frank LaFata in the general election on November 3, 2026.
